title: stardust deploy/asset-ledger.json
description: Documents (pdf, office files, …) the source site links, re-hosted into the code repository's docs/ by deploy/scripts/rehost-docs.mjs. Keyed by the absolute source URL (WHATWG form, no fragment), keys sorted; written under a lock, only when its bytes change. The sibling encoder rewrites a link whose absolute URL is a key to its path; a document link with no entry stays absolute and is reported in linksUnresolved. A failed fetch is never recorded.

path.description: root-relative URL of the re-hosted copy, served from the code repository (docs/<file>)
